label: Smart speaker, Wi-Fi only
description: 5th-generation Echo Dot (2022) smart speaker with a 1.73-inch front-firing driver and Alexa. Dual-band 802.11a/b/g/n/ac Wi-Fi and Bluetooth; there is no Ethernet port.
notes: Wireless only - 2.4/5 GHz 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, no RJ45, no PoE; 15 W USB-C power adapter. Always-on cloud sessions keep a NAT mapping and a steady trickle of traffic, which is the realistic background load in a home lab.
